parts.zh: 纽约市警方周二在展望公园抓获了一头走失的奶牛
M: 请告诉我们更多信息
W: 它会讲科学，各种各样的科学
W: 有点像。它会像纪录片那样是非虚构的
M: 好的,所以它既有教育性又有娱乐性
M: 好,谢谢。我想我们对节目会是什么样基本清楚了
W: 好的,当然。基本上我们需要你们提供资金支持
M: 每当看到别人取得成就时
W: 听着,如果你总是拿自己和别人比较

items.stem: What happened in New York's Prospect Park on Tuesday?

choices.text: Many facilities were destroyed by a wandering cow.
choices.zh: 许多设施被一头游荡的奶牛破坏了。

choices.text: A wandering cow knocked down one of its fences.
choices.zh: 一头游荡的奶牛撞倒了其中一道围栏。

choices.text: Some tourists were injured by a wandering cow.
choices.zh: 一些游客被一头游荡的奶牛弄伤了。

choices.text: A wandering cow was captured by the police.
choices.zh: 一头游荡的奶牛被警方捕获了。

items.stem: What do we learn about the cow from the end of the news report?

choices.text: It was shot to death by a police officer.
choices.zh: 它被一名警察开枪打死了。

choices.text: It found its way back to the park's zoo.
choices.zh: 它自己找到了回公园动物园的路。

choices.text: It became a great attraction for tourists.
choices.zh: 它成了游客的一大景点。

choices.text: It was sent to the animal control department.
choices.zh: 它被送到了动物管理部门。

items.stem: What does the news report say about the fossil hall of the National Museum of Natural History?

choices.text: It is the largest of its kind.
choices.zh: 它是同类展厅中最大的。

choices.text: It is going to be expanded.
choices.zh: 它将要扩建。

choices.text: It is displaying more fossil specimens.
choices.zh: 它正在展出更多化石标本。

choices.text: It is starting an online exhibition.
choices.zh: 它正在启动一个在线展览。

items.stem: What is on display this week in the museum's resident exhibition hall?

choices.text: A collection of bird fossils from Australia.
choices.zh: 一批来自澳大利亚的鸟类化石收藏。

choices.text: Photographs of certain rare fossil exhibits.
choices.zh: 某些罕见化石展品的照片。

choices.text: Some ancient wall paintings from Australia.
choices.zh: 一些来自澳大利亚的古代壁画。

choices.text: Pictures by winners of a wildlife photo contest
choices.zh: 野生动物摄影比赛获奖者的照片。

items.stem: What have six birds been trained to do at a French historical theme park?

choices.text: Pick up trash.
choices.zh: 捡拾垃圾。

choices.text: Amuse visitors.
choices.zh: 娱乐游客。

choices.text: Deliver messages.
choices.zh: 传递消息。

choices.text: Play with children.
choices.zh: 与儿童玩耍。

items.stem: Why were rooks chosen by the park manager?

choices.text: They are especially intelligent.
choices.zh: 它们特别聪明。

choices.text: They are children's favorite.
choices.zh: 它们是孩子们的最爱。

choices.text: They are quite easy to tame.
choices.zh: 它们相当容易驯服。

choices.text: They are clean and pretty.
choices.zh: 它们干净又漂亮。

items.stem: What is the concern of some parents?

choices.text: Children may be harmed by the rooks.
choices.zh: 孩子们可能会被白嘴鸦伤害。

choices.text: Children may be tempted to drop litter.
choices.zh: 孩子们可能会受诱惑乱扔垃圾。

choices.text: Children may contract bird diseases.
choices.zh: 孩子们可能会感染鸟类疾病。

choices.text: Children may overfeed the rooks.
choices.zh: 孩子们可能会过度喂食白嘴鸦。

items.stem: What do we learn about the TV show Science Nation?

choices.text: It will be produced at Harvard University.
choices.zh: 它将在哈佛大学制作。

choices.text: It will be hosted by famous professors.
choices.zh: 它将由著名教授主持。

choices.text: It will cover different areas of science.
choices.zh: 它将涵盖不同的科学领域。

choices.text: It will focus on recent scientific discoveries.
choices.zh: 它将聚焦于最新的科学发现。

items.stem: In what way will the TV show Science Nation differ from traditional documentaries?

choices.text: It will be more futuristic.
choices.zh: 它将更具未来感。

choices.text: It will be more systematic.
choices.zh: 它将更加系统化。

choices.text: It will be more entertaining.
choices.zh: 它将更具娱乐性。

choices.text: It will be easier to understand.
choices.zh: 它将更容易理解。

items.stem: Who will be the intended audience of the TV show Science Nation?

choices.text: People interested in science.
choices.zh: 对科学感兴趣的人。

choices.text: Youngsters eager to explore.
choices.zh: 渴望探索的年轻人。

choices.text: Children in their early teens.
choices.zh: 十几岁出头的儿童。

choices.text: Students majoring science.
choices.zh: 主修理科的学生。

items.stem: What does the woman want the man to do for the TV show?

choices.text: Offer professional advice.
choices.zh: 提供专业建议。

choices.text: Provide financial support.
choices.zh: 提供资金支持。

choices.text: Help promote it on the Internet.
choices.zh: 帮助在互联网上推广它。

choices.text: Make episodes for its first season.
choices.zh: 为其第一季制作节目。

items.stem: How does the man feel about himself?

choices.text: Unsure.
choices.zh: 不确定。

choices.text: Helpless.
choices.zh: 无助。

choices.text: Concerned.
choices.zh: 担忧。

choices.text: Dissatisfied.
choices.zh: 不满意。

items.stem: What does the woman think is the man's problem?

choices.text: He is too concerned with being perfect.
choices.zh: 他过于关注做到完美。

choices.text: He loses heart when faced with setbacks.
choices.zh: 他在面对挫折时会灰心丧气。

choices.text: He is too ambitious in achieving goals.
choices.zh: 他在实现目标方面过于雄心勃勃。

choices.text: He takes on projects beyond his ability.
choices.zh: 他承担超出自己能力的项目。

items.stem: How does the man feel when he sees others accomplishing things?

choices.text: Embarrassed.
choices.zh: 尴尬。

choices.text: Unconcerned.
choices.zh: 不在意。

choices.text: Miserable.
choices.zh: 痛苦。

choices.text: Resentful.
choices.zh: 怨恨。

items.stem: What does the woman suggest the man do?

choices.text: Try to be optimistic whatever happens.
choices.zh: 无论发生什么都努力保持乐观。

choices.text: Compare his present with his past only.
choices.zh: 只将他的现在与他的过去进行比较。

choices.text: Always learn from others' achievements.
choices.zh: 始终从他人的成就中学习。

choices.text: Treat others the way he would be treated.
choices.zh: 以他希望被对待的方式对待他人。

items.stem: What advantage does the speaker say girls from single-sex schools have over those from coeducational schools?

choices.text: They have a stronger sense of social responsibility.
choices.zh: 她们有更强的社会责任感。

choices.text: They are more likely to succeed in the humanities.
choices.zh: 她们更有可能在人文学科方面取得成功。

choices.text: They are more likely to become engineers.
choices.zh: 她们更有可能成为工程师。

choices.text: They have greater potential to be leaders.
choices.zh: 她们有更大的潜力成为领导者。

items.stem: What do teachers tend to do in coeducational settings?

choices.text: Praise girls who like to speak up frequently.
choices.zh: 表扬喜欢频繁发言的女生。

choices.text: Encourage girls to solve problems on their own.
choices.zh: 鼓励女生自己解决问题。

choices.text: Insist that boys and girls work together more.
choices.zh: 坚持让男生和女生更多地一起合作。

choices.text: Respond more positively to boys comments.
choices.zh: 对男生的评论给予更积极的回应。

items.stem: What are teachers more likely to do in an all-girls school?

choices.text: Offer personalized teaching materials.
choices.zh: 提供个性化的教学材料。

choices.text: Provide a variety of optional courses.
choices.zh: 提供多种选修课程。

choices.text: Place great emphasis on test scores.
choices.zh: 非常重视考试成绩。

choices.text: Pay extra attention to top students.
choices.zh: 对优等生给予额外关注。

items.stem: What does the speaker find out about Seattle?

choices.text: It often rains cats and dogs.
choices.zh: 经常下倾盆大雨。

choices.text: It seldom rains in summer time.
choices.zh: 夏季很少下雨。

choices.text: It does not rain as much as people think.
choices.zh: 降雨量没有人们想象的那么多。

choices.text: It is one of the most rainy cities in the US.
choices.zh: 它是美国降雨最多的城市之一。

items.stem: Why do local people in Seattle seldom carry an umbrella?

choices.text: They drive most of the time.
choices.zh: 他们大部分时间都开车。

choices.text: The rain is usually very light.
choices.zh: 雨通常很小。

choices.text: They have got used to the rain.
choices.zh: 他们已经习惯了下雨。

choices.text: The rain comes mostly at night.
choices.zh: 雨主要在夜间降临。

items.stem: Why does the speaker say Seattle is a good place to be?

choices.text: It has a lot of places for entertainment.
choices.zh: 它有很多娱乐场所。

choices.text: It has never seen thunder and lightning.
choices.zh: 它从未出现过雷电。

choices.text: It has fewer cloudy days than any other coastal city.
choices.zh: 它的阴天比任何其他沿海城市都少。

choices.text: It has mild weather both in summer and in winter.
choices.zh: 它夏季和冬季的天气都很温和。

items.stem: What does the German professor say about muscle soreness?

choices.text: It occurs when people are doing a repetitive activity.
choices.zh: 它发生在人们进行重复性活动时。

choices.text: It results from exerting one's muscles continuously.
choices.zh: 它源于持续用力使用肌肉。

choices.text: It happens when people engage in an uncommon activity.
choices.zh: 它发生在人们从事不常见的活动时。

choices.text: It comes from straining one's muscles in an unusual way.
choices.zh: 它来自以不寻常的方式拉伤肌肉。

items.stem: What happens when muscles are damaged according to the passage?

choices.text: Blood flow and body heat increase in the affected area.
choices.zh: 受影响区域的血流量和体温升高。

choices.text: Body movements in the affected area become difficult.
choices.zh: 受影响区域的身体活动变得困难。

choices.text: They begin to make repairs immediately.
choices.zh: 它们立即开始进行修复。

choices.text: They gradually become fragmented.
choices.zh: 它们逐渐变得破碎。

items.stem: How long does it take for damaged cells to heal?

choices.text: About one week.
choices.zh: 大约一周。

choices.text: About two days.
choices.zh: 大约两天。

choices.text: About ten days.
choices.zh: 大约十天。

choices.text: About four weeks.
choices.zh: 大约四周。

items.stem: What does the speaker suggest one do to relieve muscle soreness?

choices.text: Apply muscle creams.
choices.zh: 涂抹肌肉乳膏。

choices.text: Drink plenty of water.
choices.zh: 大量喝水。

choices.text: Have a hot shower.
choices.zh: 洗个热水澡。

choices.text: Take pain-killers.
choices.zh: 服用止痛药。
